title: Student Internship Management System (PBE)
description: A comprehensive system designed to streamline and automate the process of submitting, reviewing, and generating internship documents.
fullDescription: This project is a comprehensive Student Internship Management System designed to streamline and automate the process of submitting, reviewing, and generating internship documents (TCE, Reports, and Policies). Features include dynamic document generation with ConvertAPI, robust authentication, and persistent cloud database utilizing connection pooling for serverless functions.
